sentence: This project studies how alcohol use disorder and posttraumatic stress disorder occur together in inner-city residents exposed to trauma.
This project builds deep learning models that use CT images, tissue images and clinical data to predict early peritoneal recurrence of gastric cancer after surgery.
This project studies how genetic and neurobiological factors affect vulnerability to opioid use disorder in a rodent model.
This project builds computational and statistical methods to find how an accumulation of mutations across many genes causes rare diseases in children.
This project provides imaging technologies and biosensors and helps researchers with microscopy experiments and image analysis.
This project develops an MRI method sensitive to pH that finds at-risk tissue and the risk of reperfusion injury in stroke.
This project makes RNA formulations that produce a protein only in specific cell types and studies how this shapes immunity to the protein.
This project develops MRI methods that measure blood flow in heart muscle to find tissue at risk in patients with atrial fibrillation.
This project uses neuropsychological tests and mobile eye tracking to describe cerebral visual impairment and builds machine learning models to predict it.
This project studies how a single nucleotide polymorphism in the mu opioid receptor gene affects nerve activity and L-DOPA-induced dyskinesia in Parkinson's disease.
This project builds computer models to find out how procoagulant agents restore hemostasis in platelet integrin disorders.
This project studies how transposable elements respond to injury and whether controlling them is needed for tissue regeneration.
This project builds a small-animal imaging system to track radioactive drugs that kill cancer cells in the body.
This project studies what causes the mitochondrial common deletion and how it contributes to age-related diseases.
This project studies the molecular changes that lead to calcification and matrix damage in human calcific aortic valve disease, using multi-omic approaches.
This project looks for genes that are repressed as tumors develop in mouse models of solid cancer and let tumors evade the immune system.
This project builds deep learning methods for medical imaging that carry out segmentation and registration regardless of contrast and resolution.
This project studies how Runx proteins control different gene programs in early T cell development and megakaryocyte development.
This project builds a library of near-infrared fluorophores with different fluorescence lifetimes to image disease biomarkers in head and neck cancer models.
This project uses neuroimaging and computational modeling to study how working memory and long-term memory shape representations in visual cortex.
